authorization: mission Phase5 autonomous — actual experiment only (local-only, scope-locked, tiny CPU, no secrets, no push)

C_controls.positive: tiny MLP, must-learn -> chance (sanity: learns on train, chance on held-out structure)

runner.layout: thin glue: parse protocol verbatim, run tiny-CPU experiment, write raw artifacts only
runner.signatures: main(argv: list[str]) -> int; run(protocol: dict) -> artifacts (pure, no I/O inside; I/O only at CLI boundary)
runner.fail_closed: malformed protocol, malformed splits, nonfinite values -> exit 2; task/parity/split/model mismatch -> non-zero; never silent 0

caps.multi_seed: bounded (exactly the frozen seed set, run-once per seed)

seed_provenance: disjoint from all priors: confirmatory-lock [42,99,137], mag-fresh [11,33,55] (forbidden 6), pilots/other [7,21,123]. [101,202,303] collides with none; [11,33,55] NOT reused despite brief row-1 shorthand because mag already consumed it.
artifact_policy: raw artifacts only; analyzer path consumes runner artifacts only; no hand-made results; no embedded constants steering outcome
failure_policy: fail-closed: any R1-R6 violation exits non-zero; malformed/nonfinite -> 2; run failure -> 1; record outcome, no silent pass
permitted_conclusions: exploratory only; no confirmatory claim; no advantage claim; outcome recorded, not gated
